script:
# P19 reference recipe: additive component NMA (Welton 2009), generalized DerSimonian-Laird random effects.
library(netmeta)
TE <- c(-0.45, -0.3, -0.2, -0.4, -0.55, -0.3, -0.12, -0.18)
seTE <- c(0.12, 0.1, 0.11, 0.14, 0.15, 0.13, 0.1, 0.11)
treat1 <- c("drug+exercise", "drug", "exercise", "drug+education", "drug+education+exercise", "education+exercise", "drug", "drug+exercise")
treat2 <- c("control", "control", "control", "control", "control", "control", "exercise", "drug")
dc <- netmeta::discomb(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab = seq_along(TE),
  inactive = "control", sep.comps = "+", common = TRUE, random = TRUE, backtransf = FALSE)
# tau2 is R's own value: NA (exported as null) when the additive model has zero residual df.
z <- list(tau2 = dc$tau^2, Q = dc$Q.additive, df = dc$df.Q.additive)
z[["components_0_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comp.random[match("drug", dc$comps)])
z[["components_0_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComp.random[match("drug", dc$comps)])
z[["components_0_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comp.random[match("drug", dc$comps)])
z[["components_0_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comp.random[match("drug", dc$comps)])
z[["components_1_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comp.random[match("education", dc$comps)])
z[["components_1_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComp.random[match("education", dc$comps)])
z[["components_1_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comp.random[match("education", dc$comps)])
z[["components_1_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comp.random[match("education", dc$comps)])
z[["components_2_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comp.random[match("exercise", dc$comps)])
z[["components_2_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComp.random[match("exercise", dc$comps)])
z[["components_2_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comp.random[match("exercise", dc$comps)])
z[["components_2_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comp.random[match("exercise", dc$comps)])
z[["combinations_0_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("drug", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_0_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("drug", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_0_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("drug", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_0_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("drug", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_1_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("drug+education", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_1_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("drug+education", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_1_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("drug+education", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_1_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("drug+education", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_2_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("drug+education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_2_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("drug+education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_2_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("drug+education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_2_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("drug+education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_3_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("drug+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_3_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("drug+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_3_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("drug+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_3_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("drug+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_4_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_4_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_4_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_4_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("education+exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_5_est"]] <- unname(dc$Comb.random[match("exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_5_se"]] <- unname(dc$seComb.random[match("exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_5_lo"]] <- unname(dc$lower.Comb.random[match("exercise", dc$trts)])
z[["combinations_5_hi"]] <- unname(dc$upper.Comb.random[match("exercise", dc$trts)])
cat("ALMJSON:{", paste(sprintf('"%s":%s', names(z), vapply(z, function(x) if (length(x) != 1L || is.na(x)) "null" else sprintf("%.17g", x), "")), collapse = ","), "}\n", sep = "")
